The problem

You care, but lifemoves way too fast.

You care, but life
moves way too fast.

The unfortunate pattern we know all too well

Most relationships don’t disappear because we stop caring. They fade because our attention gets pulled in a hundred directions, and we lose track of what matters most.

Things get loud.

Work, errands, travel, texts, and daily noise crowd out the people you still care about.

Time gets weird.

A few days becomes a few weeks. Then guilt creeps in and reaching out somehow feels harder.

We lose touch.

Not because anyone stopped caring. The relationship just got pushed into the background for too long.

How It Started

“I have been feelingso neglected lately.”

One message changed the way I thought about showing up.

My wife often travels for work, and during one of those trips, I received this text on a random Tuesday afternoon because she felt I was not initiating enough.

That was difficult to hear because it did not reflect how I felt about her at all. I cared deeply. But I was focused on work, moving quickly, and assuming that what I felt was already obvious.

The problem was not love. It was that love was staying in my head instead of consistently showing up in the relationship.
Kris AslesonFounder of HoldClose

FAQ

A few things you mightbe wondering.

A few things you might be wondering.

What exactly does HoldClose do?

HoldClose helps you be more intentional about the relationships you care about. You can set a natural rhythm for each person, get thoughtful reminders, reach out, reflect on how connected you feel, save notes, and see relationship patterns over time.

Do the other people need to use HoldClose too?

No. HoldClose is for you. Your friends, family, mentors, and other important people do not need an account or the app for it to work.

Is this another social network?

No. There is no public feed, follower count, posting pressure, or social performance. HoldClose is built to help you invest in the relationships you already have.

How many relationships can I add for free?

You can start with your first three relationships for free and use the core HoldClose experience to see how it fits into your life.

What is a reflection window?

A reflection window is a flexible period you set for a relationship. Instead of forcing you into rigid daily habits, HoldClose gives you space to notice how connected you feel and decide whether it is time to reach out.

Can I customize reminders for different people?

Yes. Different relationships have different rhythms. HoldClose lets you customize reminders and timing relationship by relationship rather than treating everyone the same.

What does HoldClose AI use?

HoldClose AI can use context you have chosen to save, such as notes, reflections, and connection history, to offer prompts, perspective, and relationship coaching specific to that relationship.

What about privacy?

HoldClose is designed around private relationship context rather than public sharing. Your notes and reflections are there to help you remember and understand your relationships, not to create content for other people.

What are HoldClose’s mission and vision?

Our mission is to help people turn care into consistent, intentional action by using technology to better invest in their relationships. Our vision is to inspire more than one billion additional intentional actions between people who want to stay close.
